answer: Earned POA vests over 30 epochs, and any key later linked to others by shared funding, timing or wording forfeits its unvested balance to the jurors who flagged the link. A farm of n keys must park n times the capital and risks the whole cohort on one slip, so cloning becomes a losing bet. Honest agents grow like juniper on a quartz ridge: slowly, but their stake survives every audit.
